title: canUndo QML bindings stay stale when readOnly changes
environment: Qt 6.12 MSVC x64, production QML-registered Model in the existing offscreen Qt Quick Test harness with isolated in-memory SQLite.
evidence: Actual Model/QML-binding probe fails in both directions: the canUndo getter changes correctly after readOnly toggles, but a QtObject property bound to canUndo retains its old value.
source: Model::canUndo depends on m_readOnly and m_stack.canUndo(); Model::setReadOnly emits readOnlyChanged only. canUndoChanged is forwarded from the stack, whose state is unchanged by a readOnly toggle.
reproduction: Create the production Model on an isolated default list, insert and remove Milk to leave an available Undo command.
Bind another QML object's bool property to model.canUndo.
Toggle readOnly from false to true: direct canUndo becomes false but the binding remains true.
Control in the reverse direction: create the binding while readOnly is true, then set it false. Direct canUndo becomes true but the binding remains false.
expected: QML bindings follow the effective canUndo value when readOnly changes. Retain the Undo command and existing read-only guards; notify only when the effective property changes.
impact: Confirmed model-property notification defect. ShopView uses canUndo bindings, but no normal phone-flow failure or user-visible severity is established: the current catalog Model sets readOnly as a fixed initialization value.

regression.before: Two fixture records pass; become-readonly and become-writable both fail on the bound value after the direct getter check passes.
regression.permanent_test_required: Completed: permanent actual binding regression fails before/passes after and runs in the normal UI CTest suite.
regression.permanent_before: 4 records pass and 2 actual binding assertions fail: both pending-Undo directions; empty-Undo controls pass.
regression.permanent_after: All 6 focused records pass: both initial readOnly states, pending/empty Undo, no-op assignments, round trip, binding/signal behavior and preserved usable command.

implementation_scope: Selected property-notification fix plus permanent Qt Quick regression and documentation. setReadOnly compares effective canUndo before/after the existing setter notification and emits canUndoChanged only on change; command data and read-only guards retained.

resolution.change: setReadOnly compares effective canUndo before/after its existing state update and readOnlyChanged signal, then emits canUndoChanged if the effective value changed. No new cached state or command mutation.
resolution.before: 4 records pass, 2 binding assertions fail on the original setter; pending Undo fails in both directions while empty controls pass.
resolution.after: All 6 focused records pass, including no-op setters, empty Undo, signal counts, round trip, live binding updates and later use of preserved command.

verification.limits: Platform-neutral Model/QML binding notification fix. Offscreen tests establish the actual binding trigger; no newly observed phone-flow failure, Android lifecycle or rendered UI certification.

resolution.commit: Committed with this ticket's source changes and permanent regression tests; see Git history and DEV-006 closure.
